title: How Much Screening Buys a Second? Speed, Selection, and the Maker's Spread
abstract: arXiv:2610.21510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the spread a liquidity provider needs to break even against counterparties that can exploit a stale quote, and we place two defenses on a single scale: repricing sooner and screening informed flow. A break-even condition pins down the exact screening rate at which a slower maker matches a faster unscreened venue: the selection that buys back the extra staleness. The result requires only an integrable price innovation and therefore holds under jumps, atoms, and infinite variance. Predictable drift is a centering problem: it widens a spot-centered quote, but its cost vanishes once the quote is recentered on the expected reference. In four USDC-WETH pools benchmarked against Binance ETH-USDT from June to August 2026, the one-second benchmark innovation is sharply non-Gaussian: 73% of seconds show no price change. translated_title: 多少筛选才能换回一秒？速度、选择与做市商价差
translated_abstract: 我们研究流动性提供者为了在能够利用过时报价的对手方面前实现盈亏平衡所需的价差，并将两种防御手段放在同一标尺上衡量：更快地重新定价和筛选知情交易流。一个盈亏平衡条件精确确定了较慢的做市商要与更快的、未经筛选的交易场所相匹配所需的筛选率：即用来换回额外报价陈旧性的选择性。该结果只需要价格变动过程可积，因此在跳跃、原子分布和无限方差下均成立。可预测的漂移是一个中心化问题：它会使以现货价为中心的报价变宽，但一旦报价以预期参考价格重新居中，其成本就会消失。在2026年6月至8月期间，以币安ETH-USDT为基准的四个USDC-WETH资金池中，一秒粒度的基准价格变动呈现显著的非高斯特征：73%的秒内价格没有变化。将报价节奏从十二秒缩短到一秒可削减84.5%的预期冲击，因此十二秒节奏的做市商必须至少以……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个盈亏平衡条件，精确量化了较慢的做市商需要多高的知情流筛选率才能匹敌更快的未筛选交易场所，该结论仅需价格变动可积即可在跳跃、原子与无限方差下成立，并以USDC-WETH资金池数据实证表明将报价频率从十二秒缩短到一秒可削减84.5%的预期冲击。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a break-even condition that precisely quantifies how much informed-flow screening a slower market maker needs to match a faster unscreened venue—a result requiring only integrable price innovations and thus valid under jumps, atoms, and infinite variance—supported empirically by USDC-WETH pool data showing that cutting quote cadence from twelve seconds to one sheds 84.5% of the expected shock.
